children.text: We indeed have a great Agent Identity, Governance and Security product but this is a very legitimate research that was discovered because we "drink our own champagne". Cursor/xAI literally changed their admin settings and added the option to disable the unprompted checks. Give them more time and they'll teach the bot not to deny these actions.

This is a writeup of a claudeslop ad[1] for an agent security product. The problem in question is that the Grok harness has built-in calls on a schedule to connected services. Despite what the headline and writeup suggest, the problem does not appear to have anything to do with an LLM deciding whether to do these things.

[1]: https://newcore.com/blog/grok-bot-unattended-agent-access

title: Grok Bot took unapproved actions, ignored orders to stop, and then denied it
